name: stepped_shaft_dimensioned_from_the_side
why: ENTRY GT14. A turned part is dimensioned in the LONGITUDINAL view: the lengths between the faces and the diameters. The stepped shaft of the «revolve» example: Ø30 x 40, Ø20 x 30, Ø34 x 20. Measured on 27/9/2026: two circles seen edge-on with AddDimension2 give the distance between the faces; two generatrices of the same face give the dimension with the Ø by themselves. The lengths in parallel from the left face (the single zero, as for the holes). The Ø20, in this view, SOLIDWORKS does not expose (its face is not among the visible ones, a generatrix has a null face and cannot be selected): the answer must SAY so. Not always, though: on 28/9/2026, with SOLIDWORKS just reopened, it exposed it and it was dimensioned (the expectation on the ones not reached tells it).
defect_caught: The longitudinal view of a round part refused or dimensioned at random (before: «no dimension was born»); a chained length in place of the parallel one; a wrong and plausible diameter (edge-on AddDiameterDimension2 says 60 for a Ø30); a diameter not dimensioned and kept quiet; the same dimensions repeated in the other views.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V1 front and V2 from above (the shaft from the side), V3 side (the shaft from the end: two circles).

expect.why: a view attaches to the FILE of the part
the shaft lies on its side, along the sheet
in parallel from the left face, re-read: 40 up to the first step, 70 up to the second, 90 in all
from the two generatrices of every face, re-read with the Ø

those are dimensioned. The Ø20 has no expectation: depending on how SOLIDWORKS exposes the generatrices it is dimensioned or it ends up here with its reason. Full bench of 28/9/2026 on 0.140.0: not reached. On 0.141.0, with SOLIDWORKS just reopened and the code of the round part untouched: dimensioned, round_diameters_mm [34, 30, 20]. Both outcomes are honest
